name: pf-fix-fishing-reel-press
about: fix-fishing-reel-press against the built packages keys, town instead of the mods' source folders (tools/make_package_scenarios.py). Issue #72: the second fishing check could never be hit. One MenuForward press (a mouse click on Reel, or Return with the cursor over it) reeled twice: on the press in the window's Update and on the release through the button's func, so the second check was missed at once ("fought free") and a landing press cast again. With a whole-bar zone (hwp fishing zone 240, every reel a hit) and the cursor pinned over Reel, Return casts once, the first press in the bite is hit 1 of 2 alone and the second lands it without a new cast. A bite left alone ends "too slow" with its own text. With the slowest marker (Captain's rod, a 1-star fish) and each fight's zone where the marker gets last (hwp fishing fight worst) the window covers the marker's way plus 1.5 s and the fish lands.

allow: Resource name hash conflict in package 'mods/(HWP-[a-z0-9]+|HammerwatchPlus-All)(-gamelab)?\.bin' for file
